name: ExampleGate
description: ExampleGate 4.3.0, an IPsec VPN gateway appliance from Example Networks. Fictional: written by the working group to show a validated module and a post-quantum update.
comment: NON-CONFORMING EXAMPLE, derived from cbom-examplegate-4.3.0-product.cdx.json. It breaks one thing: mgmt-https manages keys but lists no key operations. Everything else is unchanged.

attributes.name: negotiationControl
values: IKE proposals in the gateway configuration: one ordered list of transforms per tunnel.

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: The peer must support RFC 9370 additional key exchanges for ML-KEM to be negotiated; otherwise the tunnel falls back to the classical group.
Fragmentation (RFC 7383) is on by default, because ML-KEM key shares make IKE_INTERMEDIATE messages larger than a typical path MTU.

attributes.name: moduleValidationRef
values: FIPS 140-3 certificate EXAMPLE-0001 (fictional) for the ExampleGate Cryptographic Module 2.1, embedded HSM

attributes.name: negotiationControl
values: ESP proposals in the gateway configuration, per tunnel.

attributes.name: enablementSetting
values: None of its own: ESP keys are derived in the IKE SA, so enabling ML-KEM on ike protects them.

attributes.name: moduleValidationRef
values: FIPS 140-3 certificate EXAMPLE-0001 (fictional) for the ExampleGate Cryptographic Module 2.1, embedded HSM

interfaces.name: Management web interface and REST API (HTTPS, port 443)

attributes.name: negotiationControl
values: TLS versions, cipher suites and groups under 'system tls'.

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Administrators authenticate with a client certificate or with a password and a one-time code.

attributes.name: moduleValidationRef
values: FIPS 140-3 certificate EXAMPLE-0001 (fictional) for the ExampleGate Cryptographic Module 2.1, embedded HSM

interfaces.name: Key store in the embedded HSM

attributes.name: negotiationControl
values: Not applicable: nothing is negotiated at the key store.

attributes.name: integrationConstraints
values: Private keys are generated in the HSM and cannot be exported in the clear. A backup leaves the HSM wrapped under a key-encryption key held on a smart card.

attributes.name: moduleValidationRef
values: FIPS 140-3 certificate EXAMPLE-0001 (fictional) for the ExampleGate Cryptographic Module 2.1, embedded HSM

references.comment: The supplier's CSAF provider, which publishes VEX documents for each release (fictional).
End-of-sale and end-of-support dates for each release.
Post-quantum roadmap: ML-KEM for IKEv2 and management TLS in 4.3.0; module revalidation; ML-DSA authentication once IKEv2 signatures are standardised.

variant.what: mgmt-https manages keys but lists no key operations

rules.text: Every interface it applies to states keyOperations
rules.note: The key lifecycle operations the surface offers. 'request-certificate' is listed separately from 'generate' because a tool that can generate an ML-DSA key and cannot produce a request for it still blocks the migration. Source: cprofile 'key_operations'.

fix: State keyOperations on mgmt-https. Use one of: generate, import, export, request-certificate, rotate, wrap, unwrap, derive, delete, zeroize.
